$comment: A worked example of an addon written as data rather than as Rust.
PROOF OF CONCEPT. Load it with build_registry_with(); see manifest.rs for
what this format can and cannot express.
The addresses below are FireRed (BPRE, USA rev 0). SaveBlock1 lives behind
a pointer at 0x03005008 because the game moves the block around, which is
why the reads deref rather than naming an address directly. Offsets inside
the block differ between FireRed, LeafGreen, and the Japanese builds, so
the matcher deliberately names only BPR.
How the addresses were found: tinybird-probe, two savestates taken either
side of spending money, --diff between them, then --find-u32 with the
amount to narrow the survivors. That half is the work. This file is the
cheap half, and it is the half a language model can write.
